passages.notes: The progression from consultation to selection and follow-up reading is coherent. Everyday school vocabulary supports somewhat harder phrases such as przedstawiciele and sięgnąć po. The final phrase podczas przerwy w nauce leaves unclear whether it means a holiday or a break in the school day. Use a specific period if the distinction matters.

criticalIssues: Q4 is ambiguous. A clearly works, but B can also work if the brother brings the bag to Emilia after shopping while she is still out. The stem does not require returning the bottle before shopping or forbid help during the outing.

Gdy Emilia kupuje wodę w oznaczonej butelce, płaci za wodę i dodatkowo za opakowanie. Ta dodatkowa suma to kaucja. Emilia odzyska ją, jeśli odda pustą butelkę do punktu zbiórki.

passages.notes: The narrative distinguishes a protective step from the work the customer needs to do around his own agreement. The density of formal terms makes this upper A2 at best despite short sentences and repetition. Sam zajmie się swoim kontem introduces an undefined account at the end. Removing that sentence would tighten the focus. The transition between umowa kredytowa and pożyczyć pieniądze is comprehensible, but consistent terminology would help learners.

passages.notes: The story supports B1 reading across concrete examples and a final generalization. Local disposal terms and household vocabulary are varied and anchored in actions. Bioodpady and odpady zmieszane would be more idiomatic category labels in this context. The final sentence ties back to the bins, although the preceding conclusion would also close the narrative well.

criticalIssues: The passage has an unnatural verb–object combination in bibliotekarka najpierw opowiedziała kilka zdań o autorze. Use powiedziała kilka zdań o autorze or krótko opowiedziała o autorze.
passages.notes: The passage provides a B1 challenge through cultural context, unfamiliar literature and a change in the reader’s attitude. The selected event details support the experience without requiring prior literary knowledge. Wybór tekstu zmienia się w kolejnych latach is grammatical but stiff. Co roku wybiera się inny tekst would be more idiomatic.

The other choices reuse real activities or preferences without evidence that they motivate this reread.

items.evidence: Wcześniej omijała klasyczne utwory, bo dawny język wydawał jej się za trudny. Gdy miała do wyboru kilka książek, zwykle brała do domu współczesną powieść.
